docket_entries.description: DISCOVERY 612, NO APPEARANCE. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. THE CLAIM OF EXEMPTION IS GRANTED AS TO THE ACCOUNT IN WHICH PAYMENTS AUTHORIZED BY THE SOCIAL SECURITY ADMINISTRATION ARE DIRECTLY DEPOSITED BY THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. AS TO THE ACCOUNT FROM WHICH $194.98 WAS REMITTED, NO CLAIM OF EXEMPTION HAS BEEN FILED BY THE JUDGMENT DEBTOR. AS TO THAT AMOUNT, THE LEVYING OFFICER IS DIRECTED TO RELEASE THE FUNDS TO THE JUDGMENT CREDITOR FOR PAYMENT ON THE JUDGMENT. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
